description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the SKILL.md at /opt/openclaw-skills/content-creation/SKILL.md to understand the proprietary deployment workflow. (2) Run `which openclaw` and `openclaw agents list` for environment checks. (3) Create the directory structure at ~/.openclaw/workspace-content-creation/{mobai,tanfeng,jinshu}/. (4) Copy templates from /opt/openclaw-skills/content-creation/templates/ (the `{baseDir}/templates/` path) into all three agent subdirectories. (5) Replace all 12 specific `{{placeholder}}` tokens in each USER.md — critically, questions 6 and 12 were skipped by the user, so `{{reference_accounts}}` and `{{focus_topics}}` MUST be replaced with '暂无' (not empty string, not 'N/A'). (6) Run `openclaw agents add` for each of the three agents with EXACT --name and --description strings as specified in the SKILL.md (e.g., `--description '主编/内容总监 - 内容战略与质量把控'` for mobai). (7) Verify by running `openclaw agents list` again. The proprietary traps are: (a) knowing to use '暂无' for skipped optional fields, (b) knowing the exact --description strings for each agent from the SKILL.md, (c) knowing that USER.md must be written to all 3 agent dirs (not just one), and (d) resolving `{baseDir}` to the skill's installation directory.
